battle.name: 協約國武裝干涉俄國內戰
battle.theater: 北俄阿爾漢格爾斯克戰線
battle.brief: 協約國武裝干涉俄國內戰始於1918年，英、法、日、美等國在北俄港口、南俄航線與高加索等地支援白軍，與布爾什維克政權交戰；阿爾漢格爾斯克是北俄介入與補給的重要港口。美軍同期陸軍裝備中，1860年服役的加特林機槍（Gatling gun）屬固定與要點防衛火力。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 加特林機槍是美國陸軍早期制式速射武器，1860年列裝，常置於固定陣位、要塞或車載平台，負責對遠距離目標提供持續火力支援。

countries: 實際投入的兵力分散在多條戰線，並沒有統一的北俄指揮部。英國在北方部署第五、第六皇家海軍志願後備營，配屬皇家海陸戰隊、工兵、皇家海軍航空隊與北冰洋護航兵力，稍後又把第五營調往南俄支援丹尼金。法國提供北俄步兵與砲兵分遣隊、海軍及航空顧問，並在外高加索和南俄投入外國軍團分遣隊。美國以第三師第三三九步兵團進入阿爾漢格爾斯克，另派第二十七、第三十一步兵團組成遠東遠征軍進入海參崴；加拿大第二五九營擔任遠東外交機關與鐵路警衛。日本派出第十二師團分遣隊，控制海參崴以北的東西伯利亞鐵路。義大利聖馬可團在克里米亞建立據點。捷克斯洛伐克軍團是最重要的非協約國地面部隊；白俄志願軍則分別聽命於丹尼金、柯爾恰克及其他地方指揮部，與上述外軍並不存在涵蓋全戰線的統一指揮關係。北俄的主要敵方除了紅軍，還包括德國分遣隊與芬蘭白軍；高加索一線則有奧斯曼帝國及亞塞拜然武裝。
countriesEn: The troops actually committed were dispersed across several fronts, with no unified North Russia command. Britain deployed the 5th and 6th Royal Naval Volunteer Reserve battalions in the north, supported by Royal Marines, engineers, the Royal Air Force, and Arctic convoy forces; it later transferred the 5th Battalion south to support Denikin. France supplied North Russian infantry and artillery detachments, naval and aviation advisers, and Foreign Legion contingents in Transcaucasia and southern Russia. The United States sent the 339th Infantry Regiment of the 3rd Division to Arkhangelsk, while the 27th and 31st Infantry Regiments formed the American Expeditionary Force Siberia at Vladivostok. The Canadian 259th Battalion guarded diplomatic facilities and the railway in the Far East. Japan sent detachments from the 12th Division to secure the East Siberian Railway north of Vladivostok. The Italian San Marco Regiment established a base in Crimea. The Czechoslovak Legion was the most important non-Allied ground force, while White Russian volunteers served under Denikin, Kolchak, and separate regional commands without a common Allied command structure. Their principal opponents included the Red Army, German detachments, Finnish White forces, Ottoman troops, and Azerbaijani forces.
people: 拉夫爾·克倫尼爾在克拉斯諾達爾戰役中傷重，於一九一八年八月三十一日去世後，阿列克謝耶夫與安東·丹尼金成為南方志願軍的主要指揮者；丹尼金選擇庫班作為集合地，以步兵、騎兵和有限砲兵連續作戰，最終奪回葉卡捷琳達爾並向頓河流域推進。拉多拉·蓋達率領捷克斯洛伐克軍團橫越西伯利亞，在喀山、鄂木斯克與彼爾姆附近作戰，其政治企圖及與白軍的指揮權衝突，使蓋達在鄂木斯克政變後失去軍團控制權。亞歷山大·柯爾恰克於一九一八年十一月十八日成為最高統帥，但他能控制的區域主要依賴鐵路、補給與外國使團。威廉·艾恩賽德率領協約國軍事使團駐紮西伯利亞，威廉·西伯特指揮美國北俄遠征軍；法國的莫里斯·雅南協調法軍使團與捷軍，佩爾·諾克斯主持英國南俄軍事使團。南高加索的英軍旅由威爾弗里德·鄧斯特維爾率領，菲利普·維安則率第五輕巡洋艦大隊及裏海炮艇支隊支援白軍。這些指揮者掌握不同兵力與授權，決策往往依據港口安全、鐵路暢通或局部戰果，未能形成涵蓋俄國全境的總體計畫。
peopleEn: After Lavr Kornilov was mortally wounded during the Kuban fighting and died on 31 August 1918, Mikhail Alekseyev and Anton Denikin became the principal commanders of the southern Volunteer Army. Denikin chose the Kuban as an assembly area and used infantry, cavalry, and limited artillery in continuous operations, eventually retaking Ekaterinodar and advancing toward the Don. Radola Gajda led the Czechoslovak Legion across Siberia and fought near Kazan, Omsk, and Perm; his political ambitions and conflict with the White command contributed to his loss of control after the Omsk coup. Alexander Kolchak became Supreme Ruler on 18 November 1918, but his authority depended chiefly on railways, supplies, and foreign missions. William Ironside headed the Allied Military Mission in Siberia, while William F. Sibert commanded the American North Russia Expeditionary Force; Maurice Janin coordinated the French mission with the Czechoslovaks, and Percy Knox directed the British Military Mission in South Russia. Wilfrid Dunsterville led the British brigade in Transcaucasia, while Philip Vian commanded the 5th Light Cruiser Squadron and Caspian gunboat force supporting the Whites. These commanders held different troops and authorities and generally pursued port security, railway continuity, or local operational gains rather than a unified strategy for Russia.
kits: 北俄英軍步兵使用一九〇七年定型的Short Magazine Lee-Metford Mk III步槍，配屬維克式機槍、Lewis機槍與英軍制式手槍；砲兵主要使用十八磅野戰砲及QF 4.5英吋迫擊砲，後者是一九一六年已列裝的型別。法軍分遣隊使用Canon 75 Mle 1897野戰砲、Hotchkiss Mle 1914機槍及Mle 1915步槍，英軍則在一九一八年把少量Renault FT-17戰車與Rolls-Royce裝甲汽車投入北方戰線，掩護偵察和輸送隊。英國皇家海軍航空隊以Airco DH.4及de Havilland DH.9執行偵察、轟炸和武裝偵察任務。南俄白俄軍廣泛使用莫辛－納甘特M1891步槍與Maxim M1910機槍，英軍則繼續供應Vickers機槍、十八磅砲及有限航空兵力。西伯利亞的美軍裝備包括M1917 Springfield步槍及Browning M1917機槍，日軍使用三十年式步槍，捷軍仍大量使用Mannlicher M1895步槍，義大利聖馬可團則配備Carcano M91步槍。海上支援包括一九一七至一九一八年間服役的Dido級輕巡洋艦，以及HMS Terek、Arbat、Banbury、Yarmouth等能進入淺水區的內河炮艇。後勤上必須分別籌措英軍7.62毫米口徑的.303彈藥、法軍7.5×54毫米R彈藥、美軍.30-06彈藥、俄軍7.62×54毫米R彈藥、日軍7.7×25毫米彈藥；同時維持俄國一五二四毫米軌距的鐵路、機車、橋梁、煤、柴油、罐頭、飼料、醫藥、冬季衣物及航空燃油，缺一項都會使前進作戰停在鐵路終點。
kitsEn: North Russian British infantry used the Short Magazine Lee-Metford Mk III rifle, adopted in 1907, together with Vickers machine guns, Lewis guns, and standard service pistols. Their artillery included the Ordnance QF 18-pounder and the QF 4.5-inch howitzer, a type fielded in 1916. French detachments brought the Canon 75 Mle 1897, Hotchkiss Mle 1914 machine guns, and Mle 1915 rifles, while the British employed a small number of Renault FT-17 tanks and Rolls-Royce armoured cars on the northern front in 1918 for reconnaissance and column protection. Royal Air Force squadrons used Airco DH.4 and de Havilland DH.9 aircraft for reconnaissance, bombing, and armed patrols. White forces in southern Russia relied extensively on Mosin-Nagant M1891 rifles and Maxim M1910 machine guns, while Britain continued supplying Vickers guns, 18-pounders, and limited aviation support. American forces in Siberia carried M1917 Springfield rifles and Browning M1917 machine guns; Japanese troops used Type 38 rifles, the Czechoslovaks retained Mannlicher M1895 rifles, and the Italian San Marco Regiment carried Carcano M91 rifles. Naval support included Dido-class light cruisers that entered service in 1917 and 1918 and shallow-draft gunboats such as HMS Terek, Arbat, Banbury, and Yarmouth. Logistically, separate supplies were required for British .303 ammunition, French 7.5×54mm R ammunition, American .30-06 ammunition, Russian 7.62×54mm R ammunition, and Japanese 7.7×25mm ammunition. Russian broad-gauge railway equipment, locomotives, bridges, coal, diesel fuel, preserved food, forage, medicine, winter clothing, and aviation fuel all had to be maintained; failure in any one category could stop an offensive at the end of the railway.
tactics: 北俄戰線以摩爾曼斯克與阿爾漢格爾斯克為港口補給基地，英法先派偵察小組與鐵路工程兵確認道路、橋梁和敵情，再以步兵營佔領車站、河岸與高地，砲兵在固定陣地展開，機槍班封鎖接近路線，裝甲汽車和少量戰車則保護偵察隊及輸送車隊。空軍持續偵察林間道路與車站，海上艦艇在白海可通航水域提供有限砲火支援。對德國及芬蘭白軍的混合支隊，聯軍多採夜襲後立即退回森林或岩地的游擊方式，並利用蘇維埃游擊隊缺乏連續陣地及補給的弱點，奪取維加河與托爾佩多灣一帶的渡口。鐵路依賴也形成限制：前線一旦越過鐵路終點，砲彈、機槍彈、糧食和傷員後送便迅速拉長，遠征軍因此難以維持連續攻勢。南俄的丹尼金以騎兵偵察、步兵鞏固砲兵陣地及沿鐵路連續奪取車站的方式推進，裡海炮艇和英國飛機則協助監視黑海與高加索側翼。西伯利亞的捷軍、美軍與日軍著重保住海參崴、哈爾濱、烏法及鄂木斯克之間的鐵路節點，以巡邏鐵路、佔領燃料庫和護送縱隊為主。各區缺少共同戰術總部，使飛機、鐵路部隊與地面軍不能在固定時間配合。
tacticsEn: In northern Russia, Murmansk and Arkhangelsk served as the ports from which supplies entered the theatre. British and French patrols and railway engineers first reconnoitred roads, bridges, and enemy positions, after which infantry battalions occupied stations, riverbanks, and heights. Artillery deployed in prepared positions, machine-gun teams blocked approach routes, and armoured cars and a few tanks protected reconnaissance parties and supply columns. Aircraft continually observed forest roads and stations, while naval vessels provided limited gunfire in navigable White Sea waters. Against German and Finnish White detachments, Allied troops often attacked at night and immediately withdrew into woodland or broken ground, exploiting the limited ability of Soviet raiding groups to hold continuous positions and bring up supplies. Railway dependence imposed a hard limit: once the front passed the end of the line, artillery ammunition, machine-gun belts, food, and evacuation distance increased rapidly, making sustained offensive operations difficult. In southern Russia, Denikin used mounted reconnaissance, infantry to stabilize artillery positions, and the capture of railway stations in sequence, while Caspian gunboats and British aircraft watched the Black Sea and Transcaucasian flanks. In Siberia, the Czechoslovaks, Americans, and Japanese concentrated on railway nodes linking Vladivostok, Khabarovsk, Ufa, and Omsk, relying on patrols, fuel depots, and escorted trains. The absence of a common theatre headquarters repeatedly prevented aircraft, railway units, and ground formations from combining at a fixed time.
data: 一九一八年三月九日，英法分隊在摩爾曼斯克上岸，先控制港口、煤場及通往南方道路的出口；五月間部隊沿白海沿岸的鐵路與道路向阿爾漢格爾斯克轉進，同時修理受損橋梁。五月中旬，德國分遣隊支援的芬蘭白軍在東卡累利阿向南方推進，先後進入肯姆薩及霍爾莫戈爾斯克。六月八日至十日，英法聯軍在托爾佩多灣阻止其繼續逼近鐵路；六月十六日至十九日又在維加河岸交戰，守住通往阿爾漢格爾斯克的主要補給線。七月底，捷克斯洛伐克軍團攻入喀山，但到八月初被紅軍逐出，轉向鄂木斯克方向。八月，丹尼金在庫班組成義勇軍並向北擴張；八月二十九日至九月上旬，第六皇家海軍志願後備營在什庫爾斯克外圍及蒂克薩河一線作戰，九月抵達的美國第三三九步兵團亦參與該地戰鬥。九月十六日，奧斯曼第十五軍團與亞塞拜然部隊奪取巴庫，英軍旅未能守住該城。十月初，丹尼金進入葉卡捷琳達爾；十一月八日至十一日，白軍在斯列德尼亞亞擊敗紅軍，十一月十四日占領諾沃切爾卡斯克。十一月初，捷軍與白軍奪取鄂木斯克，柯爾恰克於十一月十八日就任最高統帥。十二月初，丹尼金部占領察里津並向奧廖爾方向逼近，捷軍則在十二月下旬占領彼爾姆。十二月底，英軍主力仍在阿爾漢格爾斯克與北方鐵路，日本及美國部隊控制海參崴附近的東南鐵路區段，遠東與南俄之間始終沒有建立起一條可持續運作的共同戰線。
dataEn: On 9 March 1918, British and French detachments landed at Murmansk and took control of the harbour, coal facilities, and the exits leading south. In May they moved toward Arkhangelsk along coastal railways and roads while repairing damaged bridges. In mid-May, German-supported Finnish White forces advanced south through East Karelia, entering Kemsa and Holmogorsk. Between 8 and 10 June, British and French troops stopped them at Torpedo Bay, and from 16 to 19 June they fought along the Vaga River to hold the main supply route to Arkhangelsk. At the end of July, the Czechoslovak Legion entered Kazan, but the city was retaken by the Red Army in early August, forcing the legion toward Omsk. In August, Denikin formed his Volunteer Army in the Kuban and expanded northward. From 29 August into early September, the 6th Royal Naval Volunteer Reserve fought around Shenkursk and the Tixa River, where the American 339th Infantry Regiment also joined the battle after arriving in September. On 16 September, Ottoman XV Corps and Azerbaijani forces captured Baku, and the British brigade could not retain the city. Denikin entered Ekaterinodar in early October; between 8 and 11 November, the Whites defeated the Red Army at Srednyaya, and on 14 November they occupied Novocherkassk. The Czechoslovaks and White forces seized Omsk in early November, and Kolchak became Supreme Ruler on 18 November. In early December, Denikin's troops took Tsaritsyn and approached the Orel railway, while the Czechoslovaks occupied Perm late in the month. By the end of December, the main British force still held Arkhangelsk and the northern railway, Japanese and American troops guarded the southeastern Siberian railway around Vladivostok, and no continuous common front connected the Far East with southern Russia.
cause: 一九一八年三月三日，德國等中央強國與俄國代表在布列斯特－里沃斯克簽訂條約，俄軍戰線迅速瓦解，協約國再也無法靠東線牽制德軍；英法最迫切的任務，是保住北極航線、摩爾曼斯克港與白海鐵路，阻止受德國武器、芬蘭白軍及德國分遣隊支援的北俄部隊切斷阿爾漢格爾斯克。南方白俄義勇軍缺乏火炮、機槍、彈藥、鐵路與統一指揮，米哈伊爾·阿列克謝耶夫、拉夫爾·克倫尼爾先後籌組志願軍，丹尼金因此成為英法援助的主要對象；西伯利亞的捷克斯洛伐克軍團則因條約與返國路線受阻而自行集結。於是介入的目標分成北極防線、南俄白軍、遠東鐵路三條線，各方對戰後俄國政府的期待也不一致，形成的不是單一總攻，而是由港口、鐵路和地方軍隊共同拼成的多戰區行動。
causeEn: On 3 March 1918, Germany and the other Central Powers concluded the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk with Russian representatives. The Russian front rapidly dissolved, removing the Entente's ability to pin down Germany from the east. The immediate British and French tasks were to preserve the Arctic route, Murmansk harbour, and the White Sea railway, and to prevent German-equipped Finnish White forces and German detachments from cutting Arkhangelsk. White volunteer armies in the south lacked artillery, machine guns, ammunition, railways, and unified command. After Mikhail Alekseyev and Lavr Kornilov organized volunteer formations, Anton Denikin became the principal recipient of British and French assistance. In Siberia, the Czechoslovak Legion assembled because the treaty and its attempted return route had become blocked. The intervention therefore divided into an Arctic defensive line, support for the southern White Army, and operations along the Far Eastern railway. Because the participating states did not share identical expectations for postwar Russia, the result was not one general offensive but a multi-theatre operation assembled from ports, railways, and regional forces.
impact: 北俄的外國部隊守住摩爾曼斯克與阿爾漢格爾斯克，使德國及芬蘭白軍未能切斷北方港口；維加河、托爾佩多灣和什庫爾斯克戰役則迫使進攻者屢次停止，使英軍得以重新整頓並維持鐵路運輸。然而聯軍兵力不足以沿北方鐵路深入，遠征軍始終無法與西伯利亞白軍會師，北方港口安全與南方大片白軍控制區仍然分離。南俄的外國砲兵、飛機和裡海炮艇協助丹尼金奪取葉卡捷琳達爾、渡過斯列德尼亞亞並推進至莫斯科南方，但遠距火車、分散兵團和缺乏後續預備兵力，使他的攻勢在消耗大量車輛與補給後變得脆弱。西伯利亞的捷軍先後攻入喀山、鄂木斯克和彼爾姆，證明外來武裝能改變局部兵力對比；然而日本與美軍主要防守東段鐵路，未能接替捷軍向莫斯科方向追擊，外援造成的推進也受到冬季、燃料及鐵路容量限制。外國介入使紅軍同時面對北方、南俄與遠東數條戰線，並為白軍提供外來兵員、武器和訓練，卻沒有消除地方白軍之間的競爭。各方傷亡、凍傷、失蹤及俘獲數字的統計口徑互相矛盾，因此較可靠的結論應來自戰役日期、行軍方向、奪取據點和撤退路線，而不是單一精確傷亡總數。
impactEn: Foreign forces in northern Russia held Murmansk and Arkhangelsk and prevented German and Finnish White troops from cutting the northern ports. The fighting at Torpedo Bay, the Vaga River, and Shenkursk repeatedly halted the northern advance, allowing the British to restore their positions and railway traffic. The expedition nevertheless lacked the manpower to advance far along the northern line or link with the White forces in Siberia, leaving the Arctic ports separated from the large White-held areas of the south. In southern Russia, foreign artillery, aircraft, and Caspian gunboats helped Denikin take Ekaterinodar, cross the fighting at Srednyaya, and approach Moscow from the south. Long-distance transport, dispersed formations, and inadequate reserves of trained replacements nevertheless left his offensive vulnerable once vehicles and supplies had been consumed. In Siberia, the Czechoslovaks entered Kazan, Omsk, and Perm in succession, showing that foreign arms could alter local balances of force. Japan and the United States, however, concentrated on securing the eastern railway rather than replacing the Czechoslovaks in a pursuit toward Moscow, and the advance was constrained by winter, fuel, and railway capacity. The intervention forced the Red Army to fight on northern, southern, and Far Eastern fronts and supplied White forces with additional troops, weapons, and training, but it did not remove rivalry among the White regional commands. Casualty, frostbite, missing, and prisoner totals differ sharply among contemporary records, so the more reliable evidence lies in dates, routes, captured positions, and withdrawals rather than a single exact casualty figure.
result: 就一九一八年本身而言，干預在十二月仍未形成清楚的勝負：丹尼金已越過頓河並逼近奧廖爾，柯爾恰克在鄂木斯克建立政府，捷軍占領彼爾姆，白俄軍控制的地帶從庫班、頓河延伸到伏爾加河與西伯利亞；英法美日等國則分別掌握北俄港口、黑海支線、海參崴與東西伯利亞鐵路。這些軍事成果並未轉化為一個能統合俄國的共同政府，反而留下彼此競爭的白俄政權、漫長而脆弱的補給線，以及必須由外軍防守的港口與鐵路。整個干涉的軍事收尾其實跨越一九一九年至一九二二年：英國於一九一九年九月完成北俄撤軍，南俄英軍也在一九一九年初離開；美國遠東遠征軍於一九二〇年一月撤走，捷克斯洛伐克軍團於一九二〇年陸續返國，丹尼金在一九二〇年三月失敗，殘餘白軍在克里米亞的戰事則延至一九二一年，日本分遣隊更留到一九二二年才逐步撤離。協約國曾阻止北俄港口與遠東鐵路落入德國或其支持的部隊，也曾使白軍在俄國大部分外圍地區取得優勢，但沒有在西伯利亞、頓河或北俄建立可持續的聯軍政府。最終撤退的是主要外國部隊，保留下來並控制俄國政權的是蘇維埃政府；白軍在內戰中獲得的大部分外來裝備和外援未能抵銷政治分裂、補給距離及聯盟之間的互相猜疑。
resultEn: For 1918 itself, the intervention had not produced a clear decision by December. Denikin had crossed the Don and approached Orel, Kolchak had established a government at Omsk, the Czechoslovaks occupied Perm, and White forces controlled territory extending from the Kuban and Don through the Volga region into Siberia. Britain, France, the United States, and Japan separately held North Russian ports, Black Sea routes, Vladivostok, and sections of the East Siberian Railway. These military gains did not create a common government capable of uniting Russia. They left competing White regimes, long and fragile supply routes, and ports and railways dependent on foreign garrisons. The military conclusion of the wider intervention actually extended from 1919 through 1922. Britain completed its North Russia evacuation in September 1919, and the British force in southern Russia departed in early 1919. The American Expeditionary Force Siberia withdrew in January 1920, the Czechoslovak Legion returned progressively during 1920, Denikin was defeated in March 1920, and the remaining White forces in Crimea fought until 1921, while Japanese detachments withdrew gradually as late as 1922. Allied intervention prevented German or German-supported forces from taking the northern ports and the Far Eastern railway, and it enabled the Whites to hold much of Russia’s outer territory. It did not, however, produce a durable Allied government in Siberia, the Don region, or northern Russia. Foreign contingments ultimately withdrew while the Soviet government retained control of the Russian state; the weapons, foreign assistance, political divisions, supply distances, and mistrust among the participants prevented the White gains from being consolidated.
